updates.note: Management reiterates the full year volume growth guidance in the band of 8-10%.
updates.quote: Overall, we have given our direction that we should stay in the volume region of about 8-10%.

updates.note: Management reaffirms the first phase of the VAM-VAE project commissioning by August.
updates.quote: The first phase of this initiative will commence by August.

updates.note: Management reiterates the PBDIT margin guidance band of 18-20%.
updates.quote: We are still garnering around the guidance of 18-20% of our PBDIT margins holds.

new_promises.statement: We will reach a VAE capacity closer to 150,000 MT over the next 2-2.5 years.
new_promises.quote: over a period of about 2-2.5 years, we should be able to reach basically a capacity which is higher and closer to about 150,000 MT.
new_promises.speaker: Amit Syngle
